summary: The customer wants to monitor sucrose concentration in-line for a clear aqueous sucrose solution and asks for a method and probe proposal.

facts_stated.text: The solution is clear, colourless, and aqueous.
The target variable is sucrose concentration.
The process pipe is a 50 mm stainless steel pipe.
The operating pressure is normal pressure.
The expected concentration range is 5 to 15 % w/w.
The quality limit is plus or minus 0.3 % w/w.
The reference method is a laboratory refractometer.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: laboratory refractometer is the reference method

facts_stated.text: The analyser can stand in a dry, safe room 10 m from the pipe.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: analyser can stand in a dry, safe room 10 m from the pipe

facts_stated.text: The line is cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: line is cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day

facts_stated.text: A reading every minute is sufficient.
